description: Both backup-trigger-backup.md and backup-trigger-prune.md use a `full_backup` request-body field in their worked examples (`{"full_backup": false}` and `{"full_backup": true}` respectively), but neither page documents it in prose, in a parameters table, or in the syntax block above the example - both pages' own HTTP Methods and URIs / Description / Curl Syntax sections describe the endpoint as taking no body at all. A reader following only the documented syntax would not know this parameter exists. For the PRUNE endpoint specifically, a full-vs-incremental flag has no obvious purpose for a prune operation and the page gives no explanation, raising the possibility it is a copy-paste artifact from the trigger-backup example rather than a real prune parameter.
